profile.title: From systems & networks to Salesforce development
profile.p1: A technical profile with a strong IT infrastructure background, now fully focused on Salesforce and cloud consulting.
profile.p2: I started my career on the infrastructure side — internship at MIDRANGE GROUP (Feb – May 2023) as a junior systems & network administrator: support for 50+ workstations, deployment of 200 Dell machines via Windows Autopilot, Windows Server 2022 administration (AD DS, DNS, DHCP, GPO), PfSense/Squid, Acronis, Datto RMM. This hands-on experience taught me how systems behave in real life and why solid foundations matter.
profile.p3: From Oct. 2023 to Oct. 2025, I worked as a Salesforce Developer at LD Digitales (remote) while earning the Développeur Concepteur Logiciel title (RNCP Level 6) from OpenClassrooms. I built and maintained 10+ Apex classes, created 20+ automation Flows (reducing manual workload by 30%), designed reusable LWC components, and implemented CI/CD pipelines with Salesforce CLI.
profile.p4: I do my best work in environments that value autonomy, transparency, and continuous learning. My 2026 goal is to work internationally as a freelance Salesforce developer & consultant, collaborating with distributed teams and clients in France and abroad.
profile.p1_salesforce: Salesforce developer & consultant: I design reliable, secure, maintainable solutions with a strong focus on user experience and delivery quality.
profile.p2_salesforce: I work with Apex, Flows, data models, security (permission sets, sharing), and CI/CD pipelines (Salesforce CLI, GitHub Actions) to ship cleanly to production.
profile.p3_salesforce: My systems & DevOps background helps me approach Salesforce with an operations mindset: observability, risk management, documentation, and automation—so solutions stay robust over time.
profile.p4_salesforce: Available immediately — open to a permanent, fixed-term, freelance, or contract Salesforce role, in Paris / Marseille or fully remote.
profile.p1_itops: IT Ops & DevOps: I help teams design, maintain, and secure resilient infrastructure, with pragmatic operations processes (runbooks, monitoring, remediation).
profile.p2_itops: I implement operations standards: actionable monitoring/alerting, noise reduction, escalation procedures, documentation, and automation (scripts, jobs, playbooks).
profile.p3_itops: I pay close attention to security and continuity: backups, hardening, access management, and change practices to reduce incidents.
profile.p4_itops: Available immediately — open to a permanent, fixed-term, freelance, or contract IT Ops / DevOps / SRE role, in Paris / Marseille or fully remote.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.analyticsBody: This site uses Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights in production to measure Core Web Vitals and real-user performance. No personal data is collected — metrics are aggregated and anonymous. These services are disabled in development.
privacy.cookiesBody: No marketing or tracking cookies are set. One functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) stores your language preference. Vercel may set technical cookies for infrastructure purposes (CDN, DDoS protection).
privacy.formBody: When you submit the contact form, the following data is collected: name, email, topic, message, IP address, and User-Agent. This data is used solely to process and respond to your request. If Formspree is enabled as a fallback, message content is forwarded to Formspree (a third-party email delivery service based in the United States).
privacy.retention: Retention: contact messages are kept for a maximum of 90 days, then deleted. You may request early deletion by contacting us.
privacy.newsletterBody: If you subscribe to the newsletter, your email address is transmitted to Brevo (ex-Sendinblue), a third-party email marketing service. You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email.
privacy.rightsBody: In accordance with applicable data protection regulations (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, and request deletion of your personal data.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before reaching out.

items.q: Are you open to permanent roles, or only freelance?
items.a: I'm open to all forms of collaboration: permanent, fixed-term, freelance, or contract. Available immediately, I can join a team in Paris / Île-de-France, Marseille / PACA, or work fully remote from anywhere.

Yes — full remote, hybrid, or on-site depending on your needs. I'm based in France and available in Paris / Île-de-France and Marseille / PACA. Video calls, async communication, and documented handovers are part of my standard workflow.

It depends on the scope. A Salesforce audit or a focused feature (Flow, Apex class) usually takes 1–5 days. A full implementation with testing and documentation typically runs 2–8 weeks. I'll give you a precise estimate after an initial scoping call — no commitment required.

items.q: How does a typical engagement work?
items.a: It usually goes like this: a short discovery call (30 min) to understand your context → a written proposal with scope, deliverables, and timeline → delivery with clear documentation → a handover session so your team can maintain everything independently. You own all the code and configuration I produce.

items.q: Do you offer support after delivery?
items.a: Yes. I include a short support window after each delivery for adjustments and questions. For ongoing maintenance or feature evolution, we can discuss a retainer arrangement.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.commitmentBody: This website aims to be accessible to as many people as possible, in line with WCAG 2.2 guidelines (Level AA). Measures implemented include: full keyboard navigation, color contrast meeting recommended ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text), alternative text on all informative images, semantic HTML structure with ARIA landmarks, a skip-to-content link, and focus-visible indicators on all interactive elements.
accessibility.limitsBody: Some third-party content (PDF viewers, external widgets) may not be fully accessible. If you use a screen reader (NVDA, VoiceOver, JAWS) and encounter a specific issue, your feedback is welcome.
accessibility.helpBody: If you encounter a barrier while navigating this website — element not reachable by keyboard, missing image alternative, insufficient contrast, or any other difficulty — please report it by specifying the URL of the page and the nature of the problem. Contact: via the contact form or by email.
